scope: Rumo10 independent simulated career, never official future participants

official_base.national_reference: 26 retained after 6 D promotions; 2 C descents in the current base edition

simulation_adaptations.quota_version: Freeze RNF2026 allocation until a separately versioned simulation policy replaces it; not official RNF2027
simulation_adaptations.state_results: Complete official state/selective sports adapters with verified participants and NPC games, not new artificial selection tournaments
priority: federation paths with verified edition-specific rule
simulation_adaptations.duplicate_reassignment: Skip already retained and A/B/C clubs, continue down the eligible finalized sporting classification of that federation; never exceed its quota
simulation_adaptations.residual_first_transition: Four highest eligible nonselected clubs in complete finalized D2026 ranking; deterministic published rank; no imported historical result or overall
simulation_adaptations.ties: Use persisted final rank from competition adapter; its official tie criteria and saved lot. Never re-roll selection or use current catalogue/overall
simulation_adaptations.insufficient_federation_results: Block full national renewal; report UF, slots and missing qualifying tournament/results. No transfer offers for unavailable edition

ledger.application: Single existing Repository transaction only after all divisions, mandatory cups and state paths validate; no partial memberships
ledger.replay: Same canonical digest returns existing ledger; conflicting digest aborts without mutation

All 27 federation paths have enough simulated finalized eligible results
All 96 unique IDs known, no overlap with A/B/C
Mandatory current and next cups covered, including Copa do Brasil128 and new regional champions
